PMSBY Kya Hai? ₹20 Mein Milega ₹2 Lakh Insurance | Full Details 2025 | PM Suraksha Bima Yojana

Iss video mein aapko milegi puri jankari PMSBY - Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana ke baare mein. Sirf ₹12 yearly premium mein aapko milta hai ₹2 lakh ka Accidental Insurance!

Agar aap ek affordable insurance plan dhoondh rahe hain, to yeh scheme aapke liye perfect hai.

Is video mein cover kiya gaya hai:

PMSBY kya hota hai?

₹20 mein ₹2 lakh kaise milta hai?

Eligibility kaun si hai?

Apply kaise karein?

Claim kaise karein?

Aapko PMSBY se judi har important baat iss video mein milegi — wo bhi simple language mein.
